header.title: Noise
header.description: Photographic grain over the content, generated with an SVG filter (`feTurbulence`). `variant` sets the look: `grain` is a fine grain, `film` makes it drift like film stock and `static` is coarser TV snow. It shows by default; the layer is decorative and doesn't block clicks.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. `duration` only affects `film`. Change the surface to see how the grain reads on dark and light backgrounds.

base.title: Basic grain
base.description: With the defaults (`variant="grain"`, `trigger="always"`, `intensity="md"`) the grain covers the whole child. The root clips (`overflow: hidden`) and the layer inherits its `border-radius`, so the radius goes on the root.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `grain` is a fine, still grain. `film` uses a slightly larger grain and drifts it in a loop. `static` is coarser and more opaque, but it's also still: it doesn't flicker like a TV.

image.title: On an image
image.description: Wraps a native `img` with the default `div`. `film` with `intensity="lg"` gives it an analog-frame look.

surfaces.title: On different surfaces
surfaces.description: The same grain on a dark, a mid and a light surface. The grain is gray around the mid-tone and the layer blends with the content (`--gemfx-noise-blend`, `overlay` by default), so it darkens and lightens at once and shows on all three. It only blends with what's inside the root, not with what's behind it.

color.title: Color
color.description: `color` tints the grain: it multiplies the gray grain by that color (`.gemfx-noise__tint` in the filter). Any CSS color works; a token is better. Without a value, the default is near-white and the grain stays neutral.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: With `hover` the grain shows on pointer hover or with keyboard focus on the root or inside (`:focus-visible`). With `click`, each click turns it on or off. It fades in briefly (`--gemfx-duration-fast`) and turns off without a transition.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` sets the grain opacity: 70% of the value (`35%`, `55%` or `80%`) with `grain` and `film`, and 95% with `static`. Takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is the `film` drift cycle, in milliseconds; `grain` and `static` don't use it. Lower is jumpier. `delay` postpones the grain's appearance in every variant (and the `film` drift too); with `hover` and `click` it replays on each activation.

asChild.title: No wrapper (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect is applied to the single child without adding a `div`. The grain layer is inserted inside that child. Void elements like `img` have nowhere to hold it, so it falls back to the wrapping `div`.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the `film` drift in place. `isDisabled` hides the grain and keeps the content interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onNoise` fires when the grain turns on (on pointer enter or keyboard focus with `hover`, on click with `click` or on mount with `always`) and `outNoise` when it turns off, with the reason in `event.reason`. Try reaching the button with Tab. The button still receives clicks.

texts.body: Hover the card to turn the grain on and click the button.

header.title: Noise API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `Noise`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for every variant, trigger and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/noise` with its `noise.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> attributes (except color, which is its own prop) and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onFocus and onBlur run before the effect's internal logic.

items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the film drift stops; the grain stays still and visible.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) keeps the drift. Only use it when essential.
items.decorative: The layer and the svg have aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: they aren't announced and don't block clicks.
items.focus: With trigger="hover" the grain also shows with keyboard focus on the root or inside (:focus-visible), and onNoise and outNoise fire just like with the pointer. With click the root isn't focusable: the keyboard can't turn it on.
items.contrast: The grain blends with the content (darkening and lightening it) and lowers text contrast a bit. With intensity="lg" or static, check that the text stays readable.

items.variant: Active variant. `film` animates the grain; `static` raises the opacity and switches `--gemfx-noise-blend` to `soft-light`.
items.trigger: Active trigger, while the effect is enabled. Sets `cursor: pointer`.
items.on: Added while the grain is on with `click`.
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. Pauses the drift with `animation-play-state`.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`. Hides the layer and removes the animation.
items.surface: Wraps the child (`z-index: 1`). With `asChild`, the class goes on the child itself.
items.layer: Decorative layer above the content (`aria-hidden`, `z-index: 2`, `pointer-events: none`). Inherits the `border-radius`, blends with `--gemfx-noise-blend` and fades in honoring `--gemfx-noise-delay`.
items.grain: The `svg` with the noise filter. It's 136% of the host so the drift never leaves empty edges.
items.tint: The filter's `feFlood` that tints the grain. Reads `--gemfx-noise-color` through `flood-color`. It has no `classNames` entry.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Intensity, duration and delay are written inline on every render, so they only change through the props. The color is inline only when you pass `color`; otherwise you can override it from a class, like the blend.

items.intensity: Base grain opacity. Set by `intensity`; default `55%`.
items.color: Grain tint: it multiplies the filter's gray. Set by `color`; default `--gem-palette-neutral-0` (near-white, neutral grain).
items.delay: Delay of the layer fade-in and the `film` drift. Set by `delay`; default `0ms`.
items.blend: The layer's `mix-blend-mode` against the content. No prop; default `overlay`, and `soft-light` with `static`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Noise reads as defaults. You can redefine them on the root with a class.

items.intensity: They only show up as the CSS default: the `intensity` prop always writes a literal percentage inline, so redefining these tokens changes nothing.
items.durationFast: Duration of the grain fade-in. Without tokens, falls back to `200ms`.
items.easingStandard: Timing function of the fade-in and the `film` drift.
items.neutral0: Default `--gemfx-noise-color` (from gem-system, with a light gray fallback).

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content gets the grain and where the effect is mounted.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Drift cycle and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it shows, how it pauses and how it turns off.

items.children: Content under the grain: a card, an image or a panel.
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, without a wrapping `div`. With void elements (`img`, `input`) it falls back to the wrapping `div`.
items.variant: `grain` fine grain, `film` grain that drifts in a loop, `static` coarser, more opaque snow.
items.intensity: Grain opacity. Token or a number between `0` and `1`.
items.color: Grain tint (multiplies the gray grain); a token is better. Without a value, near-white: neutral grain.
items.duration: `film` drift cycle. Negative values are treated as `0`.
items.delay: Delay before the grain appears. With `hover` and `click` it replays on each activation. It also delays the `film` drift.
items.trigger: `always` always shows, `hover` on pointer hover or keyboard focus and `click` turns on and off with each click.
items.isActive: Lets the grain show. When `false` it hides it and `outNoise` receives `inactive`.
items.isDisabled: Hides the grain; the child stays interactive. `outNoise` receives `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Keeps the drift even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only when essential.
items.onNoise: Fires when the grain turns on: on mount with `always`, on pointer enter or keyboard focus with `hover` or on click with `click`.
items.outNoise: Fires when it turns off: on pointer or focus leave, on a second click, when deactivated or on unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Merged with the `--gemfx-noise-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
